Torkoal

Fire

Hoenn · Generation 3

Torkoal is a Fire-type Coal Pokémon first found in Hoenn (Generation 3). It stands 0.5 m tall and weighs 80.4 kg. It does not evolve. Its highest base stat is Defense (140), with a base stat total of 470.
